Add a small, non-intrusive display of the application version number in Mowafaqa Portal following the same rules as introduced in mowafaqa-buyer-portal application to help QA, support, and developers quickly identify the deployed build.


The version number should appear in the bottom section of the page (e.g., footer) and automatically reflect the value from the app’s configuration or build metadata. In addition to version there should be disclaimer at the beginning: 
© Mowafaqa 2026. All rights reserved. v0.33.3 Acceptance Criteria: Version number is visible in 
Mowafaqa Portal and consists of: © Mowafaqa 2026. All rights reserved
. 
<version> Value dynamically retrieved from the build configuration (
package.json
 or environment variable). Confirmed visible in all environments (DEV, STAGING, PROD). Verified during each release that the version number matches the deployed build.
